text:
nora: quick PR up to refresh the Hello World quickstartauth wording and to add a one-file go sample that uses the SDK bindings. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1461

sam: great! can you keep the go sample super tiny? just import, new client, call CreateResponse minimal. we want users to copy/paste and run.

nora: yup keeping it short. snippet:

```go
package main

import (
  "context"
  "fmt"
  "os"
  rwd "github.com/redwood/inference-go"
)

func main() {
  apiKey := os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY")
  client := rwd.NewClient(apiKey)
  resp, _ := client.Responses.Create(context.Background(), rwd.CreateParams{Model: "redwood-1-lite", Input: "Hello from Go"})
  fmt.Println(resp.Output)
}
```

mika: tiny nit: handle error for missing key and use explicit import path `github.com/redwood/inference-go/v1` per go modules.

nora: updated snippet with error check and correct import; thanks. added note about `go get github.com/redwood/inference-go/v1`

sam: also flag that we prefer REDWOOD_API_KEY in new docs, add small deprecation note for REDWOOD_TOKEN used historically.

nora: added deprecation note and a Troubleshooting 401 section mentioning key scopes and clock skew.
